# Get-ZbxScript

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the scripts that users and actions run.

## SYNTAX

### All (Default)

```

```

## DESCRIPTION

A script is a command, webhook or URL users run from a host or event menu, or an action runs as an operation. The Get-ZbxScript cmdlet reads them with script.get: all of them up to -Limit, by name with -Name (* and ? are wildcards), by id with -Id or from the pipeline, or with the whole script.get selection in -Filter. -Host, -Group and -UserGroup narrow the result to the scripts of the objects given, each a name, an id or a piped object. It writes ZabbixScript objects, with their related objects when a -Select switch asks for them, or, with -CountOutput, the number of matches; it needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get a script by name

```powershell
Get-ZbxScript -Name 'Traceroute' | Select-Object ScriptId, Name, Type, Scope, ExecuteOn, Command
```

-Name matches exactly; a * turns it into a search. The built-in 'Traceroute' script is a good one to look at.

### Example 2: List the scripts that can run on a host

```powershell
Get-ZbxScript -Host 'db-01' | Select-Object Name, MenuPath, Scope
```

-Host returns the scripts available for the host (those without a host group limit, and those limited to one of its groups).

### Example 3: List the scripts that ask for confirmation

```powershell
Get-ZbxScript | Where-Object Confirmation | Select-Object Name, Confirmation
```

Confirmation holds the text the frontend shows before running the script; empty means it runs at once.
